proposal.source:
type count = uint(0, 18446744073709551615)
type delta = int(-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807)
type selected = count
rule migrated(n: selected, d: delta) { run printf "%s:%s" "$n" "$d" }

fields.label: Definition
Grant
fields.value: Approval permits repeated invocations by this principal (including every assigned key) without another prompt.

fields.label: Privileges
fields.value: Commands run as the daemon's Unix user without gaining new privileges. This does not isolate access to that user's files or program configuration.

fields.label: Expansion
fields.value: Quoted pieces are literal text; ${name} is a binding. Pieces joined with + form one argument. No shell, word splitting, globbing or recursive expansion.

fields.label: n: selected
fields.value: Unsigned decimal integer from 0 through 18446744073709551615, inclusive. Canonical digits only: no sign, leading zeros (except 0), whitespace or overflow.

fields.label: d: delta
fields.value: Signed decimal integer from -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807, inclusive. Canonical digits with optional minus: no plus, leading zeros, negative zero, whitespace or overflow.
